findings.suggested_fix: Reset session role state whenever a pooled connection is returned or checked out, restoring the configured assume_role when present; test that a role change on one checkout does not carry over to the next.
findings.title: Pooled sessions retain request-level role changes

findings.suggested_fix: Reset session role state before a pooled connection becomes available to another borrower, restoring the configured assume_role (or the login role when none is configured); add a pool lifecycle test that changes role on one checkout and verifies the next checkout sees the configured baseline.
findings.title: OWASP A01: Pooled checkouts retain changed database roles

evidence: django/db/backends/postgresql/base.py:205:        if self.alias == NO_DB_ALIAS or not pool_options:
docs/ref/databases.txt documents `pool` as accepting a dict passed to `ConnectionPool`; an empty dict is a valid dict of default options but is falsy here.
findings.first_evidence: django/db/backends/postgresql/base.py:205:        if self.alias == NO_DB_ALIAS or not pool_options,
findings.suggested_fix: Treat only an absent or explicitly disabled pool setting as off, allowing an empty dict to pass default options to ConnectionPool.
findings.title: An empty pool options dict disables pooling
